# Third-party dependencies

`third_party/ramulator2/` is generated by `scripts/fetch_ramulator2.sh` and is
ignored by the project. The script fetches and verifies Ramulator 2.1 revision
`b30320bc9385b708e86b67ebb9f48858cc66d798`. Project-owned source and patches
are kept under `ramulator/extensions/sieve_hbm_pim/`.
